meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 AI 回复像电报一样精简,省时省钱。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果更想看要点、不想花时间读长回答。
copy.tagline_en: Make AI reply like a telegram: short, fast, cost-saving.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer brief answers and want to skip verbose AI responses.

howto.what: 启用后，回复变成极简风格：句子短，不加客套与冗词；技术信息、代码、术语原样保留，并用你正在用的语言回答。该风格持续到你说 stop caveman；遇安全警告、不可逆操作等会临时转为清楚说明。
howto.when: 当你说 “caveman mode” “be brief” 等，或输入 /caveman 命令时启用；启用后对话会一直保持，直到你说 “stop caveman” 或 “normal mode”。

say.note: 进入默认 full 档的极简回复。
等价触发；会一直持续到关闭。
切换至 ultra 档，进一步压缩。

howto.what_en: Ultra-terse replies: short sentences, no filler/politeness. Technical details, code, terms kept; replies in user's language. Persists until stop caveman; clear prose for warnings/irreversible actions.
howto.when_en: Activates when you say /caveman, caveman mode, or be brief or similar. It stays active for the session until you say stop caveman or normal mode.

say_en.note: Activates the default full terse mode.
Equivalent trigger; mode persists until disabled.
Switches to ultra level, more compression.
